10/29 KNOCK KNOCK, WAR CRIMINAL! 🚪 🇵🇸

Autonomous people of conscience return to NYT Executive Editor #JoeKahn’s house to hold him accountable for his role in the Israeli-American genocide of the Palestinian people.
